data.summary: Built and verified E209-inspired IT code entrant measurement prototype. Prototype tool tools/it_code_entrant.py queries USAspending API for PSC code recipient data and computes segment newcomer fractions, fragmentation, and obligation metrics. Verified against committed E209 results: all 5 codes match exactly (DA01: 0.2677, DA10: 0.3113, 7A21: 0.2912, 7030: 0.0, D304: 0.0), G3 kill gate fires (median 0.2677 < 0.30), bimodality pattern confirmed (3 codes ~0.27-0.31 enterable, 2 codes closed shops at 0.0). Build decision: committed prototype tool enabling reusable entrant fraction measurement across PSC codes, replacing ad-hoc experiment scripts. Raw evidence preserved in git commit 928fc489. Unknown: why 3 codes are borderline-enterable (~0.27-0.31) while 2 have exactly 0.0 newcomer fraction, and what code characteristics distinguish them. Most useful next action: refine enterable-market screen using measured entrant fractions rather than fragmentation, or apply measurement to NIH SBIR spending categories.
